kpis.description_fr: Repatha (evolocumab) PCSK9 inhibiteur. Croissance forte post baisse prix accessibilité.
kpis.description_en: Repatha (evolocumab) PCSK9 inhibitor. Strong growth post price reduction for accessibility.

kpis.description_fr: Prolia (denosumab) ostéoporose. Mature mais croissance modérée. LOE 2025 (biosimilars en attente).
kpis.description_en: Prolia (denosumab) osteoporosis. Mature but moderate growth. LOE 2025 (biosimilars pending).

kpis.description_fr: Tepezza (TED, ophtalmo) acquis via Horizon 2023 (28 Mds $). Plus gros asset Horizon, KPI à surveiller intégration.
kpis.description_en: Tepezza (TED, ophtho) from Horizon 2023 ($28B deal). Largest Horizon asset, integration KPI watch.

kpis.description_fr: R&D 22% du revenu : oncologie KRAS (Lumakras), obésité (MariTide), pipeline rare diseases.
kpis.description_en: R&D 22% of revenue: oncology KRAS (Lumakras), obesity (MariTide), rare diseases pipeline.

kpis.description_fr: MariTide (GIPR antagonist + GLP-1 agonist) Phase 3 démarrée 2024. Bet majeur obésité vs LLY/NVO. Lecture Phase 3 2026-2027.
kpis.description_en: MariTide (GIPR antagonist + GLP-1 agonist) Phase 3 started 2024. Major obesity bet vs LLY/NVO. Phase 3 readout 2026-2027.

kpis.signal: Declin continue -34% sur 5 ans, biosimilars + concurrence Rinvoq/Skyrizi, exclusivite jusqu'a 2029
kpis.description_fr: ENBREL (etanercept) anti-TNF pour arthrite rhumatoide, psoriasis. En declin tendanciel -34% depuis 2020 (concurrence Rinvoq/Skyrizi). Exclusivite USA via patent jusqu'a 2029.
kpis.description_en: ENBREL (etanercept) anti-TNF for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis. Tendential decline -34% since 2020 (Rinvoq/Skyrizi competition). US patent exclusivity until 2029.

kpis.signal: Plateau ~2.2 Mds $, psoriasis PDE4 oral, decroissance lente concurrence biologics
kpis.description_fr: Otezla (apremilast) PDE4 oral pour psoriasis/PsA. Acquis Celgene 2019 (13.4 Mds $). Stagne autour 2.2 Mds $ vs croissance attendue.
kpis.description_en: Otezla (apremilast) oral PDE4 for psoriasis/PsA. Acquired from Celgene 2019 ($13.4B). Stuck at $2.2B vs expected growth.

kpis.signal: XGEVA (denosumab oncologie) stable ~2 Mds $, perte exclusivite proche (biosimilars)
kpis.description_fr: XGEVA (denosumab) injection mensuelle pour prevention SRE oncologie. Stable ~2 Mds $. Meme molecule que Prolia, perte exclusivite USA Feb 2025.
kpis.description_en: XGEVA (denosumab) monthly injection for SRE prevention in oncology. Stable ~$2B. Same molecule as Prolia, US exclusivity loss Feb 2025.

kpis.signal: Bond +19% FY24 via integration Horizon Therapeutics (Tepezza, Krystexxa)
kpis.description_fr: Total CA produits. Bond +19% FY24 via integration complete Horizon Therapeutics (Tepezza maladie thyroidienne, Krystexxa goutte). Top line Amgen consolidee.
kpis.description_en: Total product sales. +19% FY24 surge via full Horizon Therapeutics integration (Tepezza thyroid eye disease, Krystexxa gout). Amgen consolidated top line.

kpis_story.description_fr: MariTide différenciateur : dosing mensuel (vs hebdo LLY/NVO), poids ~20% +. Phase 3 obésité critique pour valuation Amgen.
kpis_story.description_en: MariTide differentiator: monthly dosing (vs weekly LLY/NVO), ~20% weight loss. Critical obesity Phase 3 for Amgen valuation.

_notes: Gov + 8 risks couverts. 5 KPIs spec pharma franchise + 1 story MariTide race.
